column1: # 龟蛋页 11-27 用户意见后的新文案(左栏基础值 / 战斗开始 / 路名全称 / 成长写额外获得)。中文<TAB>English。
战斗开始时龟蛋被围栏护着，不能被选为目标，范围伤害也打不到，并额外获得 {C:RealtimeBattle3DScene.EGG_FENCE_RES} 护甲和魔抗。己方单位全部倒下后围栏才会倒下。
column2: When combat starts the Turtle Egg is behind a fence: it can't be targeted, area damage can't reach it, and it gains {C:RealtimeBattle3DScene.EGG_FENCE_RES} Armor and Magic Resist. The fence only falls once all of its side's units are down.

column1: 龟蛋免疫控制与斩杀。龟蛋的生命值在上路战场、下路战场和终极战场之间延续，不会回满。
column2: The Turtle Egg is immune to crowd control and executes. Its health carries over between the Top Lane, Bottom Lane and Final Battle, and never refills.

column1: 龟蛋额外获得（{C:DualLaneFlow.EGG_HP_PER_LV}×等级）最大生命值、（{C:BattleSpawn.EGG_RES_PER_LV}×等级）护甲和（{C:BattleSpawn.EGG_RES_PER_LV}×等级）魔抗。
column2: The Turtle Egg gains ({C:DualLaneFlow.EGG_HP_PER_LV} × level) bonus max health, ({C:BattleSpawn.EGG_RES_PER_LV} × level) Armor and ({C:BattleSpawn.EGG_RES_PER_LV} × level) Magic Resist.

column1: 在终极战场，以及同一方已赢下上路战场后的下路战场，围栏倒下后龟蛋受到的伤害 ×{C:RealtimeBattle3DScene.EGG_FINAL_DMG_MULT}，并每 {C:RealtimeBattle3DScene.EGG_SELFLOSS_IV} 秒损失 {C:RealtimeBattle3DScene.EGG_SELFLOSS_PCT%}% 最大生命值。
column2: In the Final Battle, and in the Bottom Lane after one side has already won the Top Lane, once its fence falls the Turtle Egg takes ×{C:RealtimeBattle3DScene.EGG_FINAL_DMG_MULT} damage and loses {C:RealtimeBattle3DScene.EGG_SELFLOSS_PCT%}% of its max health every {C:RealtimeBattle3DScene.EGG_SELFLOSS_IV} seconds.
